Sets the user's email and sends a verification OTP.
Verifies the user's email address with the OTP sent.

Sets a new password using the uid and token from the reset link.

Gets a new access token using a valid refresh token.
Returns a list of all addresses in the user's address book (snapshots are not included).

Adds a new address to the user's address book.

request.description: Performs a partial update. Only provide the fields you want to change. This is the recommended way to set an address as default.

Retrieves all items in the currently authenticated user's wishlist.
